test_title: PYST 37: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the word that has the same meaning (SYNONYM) as the underlined word in the given sentence.

The vital role played by women at home and in the struggle for freedom, advanced the case for female __emancipation __soon after the war was over.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **freedom**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"emancipation"** means the act of freeing someone from oppression, restrictions, or slavery. It refers to gaining freedom and equality. (मुक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** The emancipation of slaves was a significant milestone in the history of the United States.
 
 
 
• **"Freedom"** refers to the state of being free to act, speak, or think without hindrance or restraint. It aligns with the meaning of emancipation. (स्वतंत्रता)
 
 
• **Example:** The country celebrated its freedom after years of colonial rule.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"emancipation"** is **"freedom."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bondage** (गुलामी): The state of being enslaved or restricted.

 
 
• **Example:** Many people fought to escape the bondage of oppressive regimes.
 
 
 
• **Utility** (उपयोगिता): The state of being useful or beneficial.
 
 
• **Example:** The utility of this tool in construction work is undeniable.
 
 
 
• **Objectivity** (वस्तुनिष्ठता): The quality of being unbiased, neutral, or based on facts rather than opinions.
 
 
• **Example:** The journalist maintained objectivity while reporting the incident.
